theme: Data formats: JSON, serialization and JSONSerialization

terms.definition: A text format that stores data as keys and values, easy for people and apps to read.
terms.example: The server sends the user as JSON.

terms.definition: The process of turning an object in memory into data you can save or send.
terms.example: Serialization turns the order into bytes for the server.
terms.code:
import Foundation
let user = ["name": "Ann"]
let data = try JSONEncoder().encode(user)
print(String(data: data, encoding: .utf8)!)

terms.definition: A Foundation class that converts data to and from Swift arrays and dictionaries.
terms.example: JSONSerialization returns a dictionary, so I cast it.

video.description:
Learn to explain JSON and turning objects into data: JSON, Serialization & JSONSerialization, with real code, a quiz at the end and each example read twice (normal, then slow).

Today's terms
JSON - A text format that stores data as keys and values, easy for people and apps to read.
Serialization - The process of turning an object in memory into data you can save or send.
JSONSerialization - A Foundation class that converts data to and from Swift arrays and dictionaries.

Quiz at the end - write your answers in the comments, then watch again to check.

landscape.title: iOS JSON, Serialization & JSONSerialization | Day 199
landscape.description:
Explain JSON, Serialization & JSONSerialization in iOS by listening to a real code chat between two iOS devs.
JSON, Serialization, JSONSerialization 표현을 영어 대화로 익혀요.

JSON - A text format that stores data as keys and values, easy for people and apps to read.
한국어: JSON: 데이터를 키와 값으로 저장하는, 사람과 앱이 읽기 쉬운 텍스트 형식

Serialization - The process of turning an object in memory into data you can save or send.
한국어: Serialization: 메모리의 객체를 저장하거나 보낼 수 있는 데이터로 바꾸는 과정

JSONSerialization - A Foundation class that converts data to and from Swift arrays and dictionaries.
한국어: JSONSerialization: 데이터를 Swift 배열과 딕셔너리로, 또는 그 반대로 바꿔 주는 Foundation 클래스

In this video, Mina and Jake talk about JSON and turning objects into data, in a chat-style conversation, with the Swift code on screen.

landscape.hook: Can you explain JSON, Serialization and JSONSerialization in English?

dialogue.title: Text from the server

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Jake, the server sends text with `age` and a number. What is it?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: That is JSON. It stores data as keys and values, and people can read it.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: How do I use JSON in Swift?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: First you need serialization. That means turning an object into data you can save or send.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Reading the data back into objects. Our code does it with JSONSerialization.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Yes. It returns arrays and dictionaries, and you cast them to the type you want.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: That feels manual. Is there something easier?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Yes, Codable. But it is good to know JSONSerialization first.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Okay. Serialization is the writing, and JSON is the shared language.
The server sends the user as JSON.
